Internal Wiring:
The internal wiring between UPS No.1 cubicle, UPS No.2 cubicle, and the Bypass Transformer cubicle is not shown in the current documentation. This wiring must be clearly illustrated.
Cable Segregation:
Proper segregation of cables—power, communication, control, AC, and DC—must be demonstrated, especially considering the very limited space available in the bottom cable routing area.
Cable Support:
All internal cabling shall be installed on appropriate cable support systems, such as trays. Separate trays or compartments must be used for different cable types (e.g., power vs. control/communication, AC vs. DC) to ensure safety, minimize interference, and maintain system integrity.
Bending Radius:
The bending radius diagram for the cables is either missing or not properly shown. This must be clearly indicated to ensure compliance with cable manufacturer specifications and to avoid mechanical stress on the cables.
Cable Access Space:
The clear dimensions of the cable access space, including height and other relevant spatial constraints, are not shown. These dimensions must be provided to verify that installation and maintenance can be carried out safely and effectively.
